limitations: Prognostic associations from TCGA clinical survival analyses reflect statistical correlations with patient survival and do not establish causal tumor suppressor or oncogenic functions.

Consensus tissue RNA expression levels (nTPM) quantify baseline abundance in normal physiological kidney and lung tissues, not intra-tumoral expression in clear cell renal cell carcinoma or lung adenocarcinoma biopsies.

Missing values in pathology prognostic p-value tables reflect absence of records under specific subcategories (e.g. validated vs potential prognostic) rather than zero or complete absence of expression.
